scope: First-visit usability audit of vsites.co.kr: discovery, search, filters, bookmarks, navigation, mobile, keyboard, guides and contact.
findingsFixed: Korean names such as 챗지피티 and 테트리스 returned no matching official service; added reviewed Korean aliases for existing entries.

Opening saved sites retained unrelated search and category filters and misleadingly claimed there were no bookmarks; saved view now starts with the full saved list and distinguishes filtered-empty results.
Category pages had no save controls; shared bookmark state now works across home, all category pages and random recommendations, including cross-tab storage events.
Save feedback was below the catalogue; a short, visible live-status toast now confirms the action.
Back navigation lost search, category, sort, view and expanded result count; validated URL state now preserves them and synchronizes with Next.js navigation.
Active filters could be hard to identify or clear, especially on mobile; removable filter chips, clear-search and a reset control now provide recovery.
Card descriptions were truncated and narrow mobile cards had small save targets; complete descriptions, single-column phone layouts and 44px save targets improve reading and touch interaction.
Only card titles opened sites; the card body now opens the same destination while the save button remains separate.
Random discovery was an unexplained icon on phones, could repeat its sole candidate, and could not save; it now has a visible label, save control and conditional reroll.
Keyboard users stayed after newly appended results; load-more now moves keyboard focus to the first added site.
320px search controls overflowed during testing; corrected flex sizing and shortened the search placeholder.
Site reporting emphasized a GitHub account requirement; a prefilled email link is now the first reporting option, with GitHub as an alternative. No message was sent.

validation.productionBuild: passed; first 24 cards remain in exported HTML; every category includes save controls
browserFlows: Korean search for ChatGPT and Tetris; combined category and name sort
Save ChatGPT, search an unrelated term, then open saved sites: saved item remains discoverable
Filter saved sites to zero matches and recover using saved-sites reset
Save Slow Roads on the games page and open the shared saved list
Back navigation and reload restore search, category and sort
Top navigation clears obsolete search state and keeps URL and controls synchronized
Keyboard Enter on load-more appends 24 cards and focuses the first new site
Back navigation restores 48 loaded cards and the previous scroll position
Random reroll chooses a different site; saving works; single-candidate dialog omits reroll; Escape returns focus
A second local tab reads the saved item and removal synchronizes to the original tab
Clicking the first card description opens Neal.fun in a new tab
Desktop list view has no horizontal overflow
Contact email destination and prefilled subject/body inspected without sending
Guide index, article body and four related destinations inspected
No browser error or warning logs observed on the local tested page
